# Proposal for the sharing of economic burdens generated by the energy transition to achieve a carbon neutral interconnected system in Colombia

The energy transition and the integration of distributed energy resources present challenges and opportunities for the electricity network in Colombia, from economic, technical, environmental and market perspectives. This change encourages the creation of markets for flexible services, integrating these resources into the planning and operation of the network. However, it is crucial to carry out a cost-benefit analysis to determine the viability of these technologies in the face of conventional solutions and to ensure a fair distribution of costs among market agents. This thesis develops a cost-benefit analysis model that allows comparison of conventional solutions and services of flexibility, considering criteria of economic distribution. A review of the Colombian electricity market is carried out, evaluating the challenges of the energy transition and the integration of distributed energy resources present challenges and opportunities for Colombia's electricity market comparison and flexibility implementation as possible solutions . r of a potential flexibility services market, and a case study is evaluated on high voltage line overloads, analysis repowering, infrastructure construction, or the implementation of flexibility services as potential solutions
